The '''Peroenian Monarchy''' was the government of the [[Peroenian]]s, a [[Near-Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that originated in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. The [[Peroen-Se]] acted as the representative of the Peroenian Monarchy on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Giaca]].
